scope: offline/static F7 step-length value lifecycle (no hardware touched)

canonical.ui_tip: 步长精度影响摇杆的精确度

origin.answer: device event frame (write-shaped, >=7 bytes); no local/cloud source found
evidence: step_accuracy/stepLength: 24/27 asm hits, 0 hits in APK assets -> no server/profile field

storage.answer: page state field_23 (set by the handler's follow-up closure 0xab9764 @0xab97d8)

request.answer: BluetoothModel.getStepLength (0x8b4d30) builds A5 04 F7 <cks> and writes it; no await of a reply, no callback, no pending flag, no version gate

delivery.answer: polled + event-driven: _scheduleStepLengthRead registers a closure in a static listener list; that closure calls _requestStepLength, which sends the read up to 3 times with a delay between attempts and stops when field_23 becomes non-null
evidence: _scheduleStepLengthRead 0xa6e178 appends AllocateClosure(0xa6e2d8) to static list (0x678 -> field_53)

_requestStepLength 0xa6e320: stores true to field_1b (re-entrancy guard), cmp x1,#3 loop cap, Provider.of<BluetoothModel>().getStepLength() @0xa6e40c-0xa6e428, Future.delayed between attempts, LoadField field_23 @0xa6e3fc -> break

ui_state.answer: state field_23 read by _setKeyExchange (0x95c578) which passes LoadInt32Instr(field_23) to writeStepLengthConfig (0x9445d4)
ui_state.grade: STRONG EVIDENCE (device-origin field; the UI edit step is INFERRED)

write.answer: writeStepLengthConfig builds A5 <len> F7 <flag> <lo> <hi> [extra] <cks>; length = ((flag & 2) + 14)/2 => 7 or 8 bytes; 16-bit LE value; checksum via define::getCheckSum

persistence.answer: direct characteristic write (BluetoothManager::write) - no D6/D7 commit observed in the F7 path
persistence.note: durability of an F7 write is UNKNOWN until a guarded write + power-cycle readback is run
evidence: writeStepLengthConfig terminates in BluetoothManager::write (direct characteristic write)
no D6/D7/D8 frame is built on the F7 path (same as writeDpiConfig @0x9468e0)
no 0xb6c (zkmVersion) reference inside getStepLength -> the read itself is ungated

inbound_dispatch.generic_envelope: A5 05 FF <opcode> <cks> (e.g. A5 05 FF FC A5) is the model-agnostic reply envelope; F7 does NOT use it - the F7 consumer is a per-page stream listener, not a switch arm
inbound_dispatch.producer: notify callback 0xacb7f8: if payload non-empty -> field_43.add(payload)
inbound_dispatch.verdict: an F7 event frame would be delivered generically by the stream; no F7-specific opcode switch is needed

searched: 3 decoded btmon.txt captures (0 unsolicited RX; every RX within 2.0 s of a TX)
official app live session official-att.jsonl: 250 ATT records, opcode histogram {02:155, d2:6, ef:2, 0b:2, e2:2, d4:2, d6:1}, ZERO records containing 'f7'
device_initiated_events.caveat: the official trace is a D2/button session - the app was not on the step-accuracy page, so its F7 absence is expected and is not evidence about F7 itself
device_initiated_events.grade: STRONG EVIDENCE for 'no unsolicited config events in the captures held'; UNKNOWN in general

value_source_answer: the displayed/current step-length value can only come from a device F7 event frame; the app has no local, D6, profile, or cloud source for it

flag_and_extra_byte.flag_semantics: UNRESOLVED (candidates: stick side / enable / precision class) - no UI string ties it yet
flag_and_extra_byte.extra_byte: present only in the 8-byte form; source UNKNOWN
